claim: Pilot better lighting and one added safe crossing in a bounded area, and run the same survey before and after.
uncertainty: Cost and effect are invented placeholders until a pilot runs.
assumptions: I assume the pilot area can be chosen without targeting any group.
mechanism: Install lighting and a crossing in the pilot area, then repeat the perceived-safety survey with the same method.
authority: Within the municipality's own street and lighting duties (stub, not judged).
success_metric: Share who feel unsafe after dark falls by five points
risks: The effect may be small or not last.
A pilot area may be chosen unfairly.
lawful_alternatives: Publish waiting times in a plain table.
